name: Gr. Sarantis S.A.
summary: Gr. Sarantis S.A., together with its subsidiaries, produces and trades in cosmetics, household products, and pharmaceutical items in Greece, Portugal, Poland, Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, Slovenia, Croatia, Czech-Slovakia, Hungary, and Ukraine. It operates through Beauty/Skin/Sun Care, Personal Care, Home Care Solutions, Private Label, and Strategic Partnerships segments. The company offers personal and health care products, including food supplements, health and self-care, baby care, body wash, deodorants, fragrances, grooming, hair care and styling, hand wash, oral care, personal hygiene, and skin and sun care.
